knowledge_base.article: Qdrant is an open-source vector database and similarity search engine. It stores high-dimensional vectors (embeddings) together with a JSON payload and lets you search for the nearest vectors to a query. It exposes a REST API and a faster gRPC API, and ships a web dashboard for inspecting collections.

A deep agent is an agent pattern that combines explicit planning, long-lived instructions, a virtual file system, and the ability to call tools and delegate to sub-agents. The deepagents library implements this pattern on top of LangGraph, so a deep agent is a compiled graph you can invoke or stream.

Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves a language model's answers by first retrieving relevant passages from an external knowledge base and then conditioning the model on those passages. A typical pipeline parses source documents, splits them into chunks, embeds the chunks into vectors, and stores them in a vector database such as Qdrant. At query time the question is embedded and the most similar chunks are retrieved and passed to the model.

FastEmbed is a lightweight, fast embedding library maintained by the Qdrant team. It runs embedding models locally on CPU using ONNX, so it needs no API key. The model BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 produces 384-dimensional vectors and is a good default for English text.
